changes: Implemented policy-authorized unattended dispatch in Lattice CLI: dispatch_auto now enforces policy scope, command allowlists, env filtering, runtime timeout, runner metadata, watch/review/merge evidence, and updated smoke coverage.
usage: Use lattice dispatch_policy_create/check to authorize a bounded policy, then lattice dispatch_auto --storyId=<story> --policy=<policy>, inspect with dispatch_watch and dispatch_review, and use dispatch_merge_plan for manual-only merge guidance.
expectedOutcome: A real user flow creates a story and authorized policy, starts fake dispatch_auto, sees accepted_local evidence, manualOnly merge guidance, authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, and out-of-policy paths refused.
actualTranscript: Temporary-project CLI run created Story B-4625, authorized policy demo-safe, dispatch_auto returned accepted_local for D-B-4625-fake-mpylydt1, watch/review/merge showed runner evidence and manualOnly:true, and README.md override was refused by policy scope.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. The only noted constraints are product-consistent: dispatch_auto requires a real story id and output paths must be repository-relative.
limitations: Real Claude Code/Gemini/Codex unattended execution remains supervised/refused until their noninteractive guarantees are stronger; fake host is the deterministic unattended path for this release.
pitfalls: Reviewer found real policy-boundary gaps: dispatch_auto originally accepted caller path/command overrides and inherited parent env. Also validate snapshots must be refreshed after evidence note changes.
